notes.title: About the settings for playing with SteamDeck
notes.notes: We have confirmed that those who play on Steam Deck can play by setting the compatibility tool to “Proton 8.0-5” from the properties.

notes.title: Tips on processing performance
notes.notes:
If you feel that your gaming PC has a high processing load, changing the following settings may greatly improve processing.

Tips
Change the frame rate from 60fps to 30fps.


In order to enjoy the Christmas atmosphere as much as possible, we recommend that you play this game in the highest possible image quality.
For your reference, when we played the game on SteamDeck, we were able to play the game with the “Ultra” quality setting.

notes.title: [The Worries of Santa Clauses] Scheduled for release on December 6, 2024!
notes.notes:
[The Worries of Santa Clauses]  is now scheduled for release on December 6, 2024 Japan time!
This Christmas, become a slightly different Santa Claus and deliver presents to people all over the world!

We will also be participating in Steam Next Fes October 2024!
The demo version allows you to freely play the first tutorial stage!
